name: Lady Wolf Moon Megaways

features.name: Megaways refills
features.description: Changing ways with a refill feature for consecutive wins.

features.name: Wheel of Fortune
features.description: Decides the number of free spins and the round multiplier.

review:
Lady Wolf Moon Megaways takes the moonlit wolf onto a Megaways grid, adding a refilling feature that can create consecutive wins from one spin. Wilds carry 2x multipliers and scatters lead to free spins.

The free spins are set by a Wheel of Fortune, which decides both the number of spins and a multiplier for the round, so each bonus begins differently. A bonus buy (using the wheel) and a Chance x2 option are available where permitted, but not together. BGaming rates this version very high volatility, a big step up from the original's medium rating, with a 6,000x maximum. The RTP is 96.75%. Free spins arrive about once every 136 spins on average.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 136 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
